summary: The frozen statement and complete proof are correct. The barycentric cut-vertex enumeration and vertexwise determinant maximization are exhaustive. Exact row and column scaling reduces every candidate determinant to a weighted reduced graph-incidence determinant; the cycle and leaf argument proves the claimed zero-or-unit factor. A missing positive root edge can be inserted while removing a strictly smaller edge, so every maximizing tree contains all positive root edges and every negative vertex is a leaf. This proves the stated exact product and explicit attaining simplex for arbitrary oblique cuts. Zero-height limits use nested compact cuts and convergent maximizing tuples, while constant and zero-volume cases are explicit. The centroid-capacity profile follows by exact AM-GM and has attaining equal-height configurations. The single-cut source qualification correctly includes supporting-boundary equality and is not asserted simultaneously for several cuts. Section7 has the exact d4 retained-volume and capacity gap claimed. Section8 computes all planar determinants, preserves their ratios by a join, and proves the stronger d4 fact that any contained simplex retaining the surviving extreme vertex has volume ratio at most11/288<1/16, while unrestricted capacity5/72>1/16. No all-fan assertion or circular mixed-integer theorem is invoked.
